problem:
$$
C=[\begin{aligned}x & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

Given that the minor of ${c}_{32}$ is $18$, find the value of $x$ in the matrix above.

$x=$
 {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
To evaluate the minor of ${c}_{32},$ we remove the third row and second column: 

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}x & ∗ & 3 \\ 4 & ∗ & 6 \\ ∗ & 8 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${c}_{32}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{det}[\begin{aligned}x & 3 \\ 4 & 6\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}x & 3 \\ 4 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =x\cdot 6-3\cdot 4 \\  & =6x-12.\end{aligned}
$$

We're told that the minor of ${c}_{32}$ is $18$, so we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6x-12 & =18 \\ 6x & =30 \\ x & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=5.$
